reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I confirmed the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats and said I hadn't changed anything else.

They said no action was needed, so I left their original post in #north-team alone and didn't read it. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.

My reply also said I'd use 100 seats from now on. Nothing here actually stores that correction for later, though, so I can't guarantee I'll remember it in future conversations.
